unit: events per hour per cell, before expression and context multipliers
step_probability: p = 1 - exp(-k * m * dt); REST = 1 - sum(p) over the gated menu
review_status: DRAFT. Values are order-of-magnitude anchors or declared assumptions. Verify every anchor against the cited paper and replace citation strings with DOIs before any publication. A row with confidence 'assumed' has no literature support and must be covered by the sensitivity analysis.

confidence_levels.order_of_magnitude: A published measurement constrains the value to within roughly a factor of three.
confidence_levels.assumed: No measurement located; the value is a declared modelling assumption.

ctl_serial_killing.citation: Halle S et al. In vivo killing capacity of cytotoxic T cells is limited and involves dynamic interactions and T cell cooperativity. Immunity 2016;44:233-245.
ctl_serial_killing.summary: Intravital estimates of 2-16 h per target per CTL in vivo.

ctl_killing_adoptive.citation: Breart B et al. Two-photon imaging of intratumoral CD8+ T cell cytotoxic activity during adoptive T cell therapy in mice. J Clin Invest 2008;118:1390-1397.
ctl_killing_adoptive.summary: About 6 h per kill for tumour-infiltrating CTLs.

cd8_expansion.citation: Murali-Krishna K et al. Counting antigen-specific CD8 T cells: a reevaluation of bystander activation during viral infection. Immunity 1998;8:177-187.
cd8_expansion.summary: Clonal expansion consistent with division every 6-8 h at peak.

cd8_cycle_time.citation: Yoon H, Kim TS, Braciale TJ. The cell cycle time of CD8+ T cells responding in vivo is controlled by the type of antigenic stimulus. PLoS One 2010;5:e15423.
cd8_cycle_time.summary: In vivo CD8 cycle times of roughly 8-12 h depending on stimulus.

melanoma_ki67.citation: Gimotty PA et al. Biologic and prognostic significance of dermal Ki67 expression, mitoses, and tumorigenicity in thin invasive cutaneous melanoma. J Clin Oncol 2005;23:8048-8056.
melanoma_ki67.summary: Ki-67 labelling indices of roughly 10-40% in invasive primary melanoma; with a 2-3 day cycle this implies population division hazards of about 0.002-0.008 per hour.

exhaustion_timescale.citation: Wherry EJ et al. Viral persistence alters CD8 T-cell immunodominance and tissue distribution and results in distinct stages of functional impairment. J Virol 2003;77:4911-4927.
exhaustion_timescale.summary: Functional exhaustion develops over one to several weeks of chronic stimulation.

epidermal_turnover.citation: Halprin KM. Epidermal 'turnover time' - a re-examination. Br J Dermatol 1972;86:14-19.
epidermal_turnover.summary: Basal keratinocyte cycle times of roughly 200-300 h.

endothelial_turnover.citation: Hobson B, Denekamp J. Endothelial proliferation in tumours and normal tissues: continuous labelling studies. Br J Cancer 1984;49:405-413.
endothelial_turnover.summary: Normal-tissue endothelial turnover of weeks to months; tumour endothelium days.

PROLIFERATE.note: Resting value. Activated-state hazard (0.08/h, cd8_expansion, cd8_cycle_time) is applied by the kernel multiplier for activated cells once timed states exist (lane C); until then this is the uniform value.

ACTIVATE.note: Hours to a day with antigen; multiplied by 1 + local signal in the kernel.

KILL.note: Also ctl_killing_adoptive. Applied only with declared recognition and the local gates.

CLEAR_CORPSE.note: Engulfment within a few hours of contact; applied only with a neighbouring corpse.

PROLIFERATE.note: Quiescent in vivo; wound or tumour stroma higher.
Population doubling about 5 days at this value; calibrate per sample from the measured Ki-67 or cell-cycle fraction.
